description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-pool/export (#4709, #4718) reads
the week like GET /traeger/staff-pool/: the Träger's schools, the binding
of the Träger transaction, its release, the Springer of the week, the
records with their links, the schools that ever blocked them, the blocks
of the week and the status of the Nachweise in one statement each; then
per school with an access entry the binding of its tenant transaction.
Flat in the number of Springer and blocks.
